summary: Iter48 P5 refactor tranche 3 (catalog -> routers/catalog.py + ProductIn/CategoryIn/CollectionIn/SimpleNameIn in models.py) validated. 24/24 new iter48 tests pass covering products/brands/categories/collections CRUD + KPIs + public listing + RBAC. 49/49 iter46+iter47 regression tests still pass. Frontend smoke: admin login + /console/produits, /console/marques, /console/categories (8 categories, top=Accessoires 2 086 000 FCFA), /boutique/catalog (120 produits, 274 card-ish elements) — all load clean with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/catalog.py GET /brands and GET /categories generate a fresh new_id() for every un-stored entry on every request — ID is not stable across calls (pre-existing behavior from server.py, same for GET /categories/tree extras). Harmless for display but means the id in list payload cannot be used to PATCH/DELETE unless the brand/category was explicitly POSTed first.

routers/catalog.py GET /brands/full performs an inner per-order per-item db.products.find_one lookup when it.brand is missing — N+1 pattern on 5000 orders. Consider pre-building a product_id->brand map once (pre-existing from server.py).

routers/catalog.py PATCH /categories/{cid} does an UPSERT when old is None (inserts a new category with the provided cid). This is surprising semantics for a PATCH; GET-then-404 would be more RESTful. Pre-existing behavior but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. All TEST_iter48_* products/brands/categories/collections created and deleted inside each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog refactor is clean. Catalog routes live at /api/products, /api/public/products, /api/brands(+/full,/{bid}), /api/categories(+/tree,/kpis), /api/collections(+/kpis). ProductIn requires {name, category, price} as minimum — category is REQUIRED, so any new product-creation test must include category. RBAC: stock_keeper can POST /products but CANNOT DELETE (admin/manager only). Sales can GET but not POST/DELETE. Note: /api/products/kpis, /api/products/sales-30d, /api/products/bulk-* and /api/products/{pid}/history still live in server.py and continue to work.
